# jsonld.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/jsonld.mjs)

Helpers for reading the schema.org JSON-LD used for place data.

Each place is an Article whose mainEntity is the place itself; Articles
whose creativeWorkStatus is not "Published" are drafts.

**Exports:** `getPublishedEntities`, `getPropertyValue`, `getFeatureValue`, `getFeatureKeys`

## Functions

* [getPublishedEntities(data)](#getPublishedEntities) ⇒ <code>Array</code>
* [getPropertyValue(values, propertyID)](#getPropertyValue) ⇒ <code>\*</code>
* [getFeatureValue(entity, key)](#getFeatureValue) ⇒ <code>\*</code>
* [getFeatureKeys(entity)](#getFeatureKeys) ⇒ <code>Array</code>

<a name="getPublishedEntities"></a>

## getPublishedEntities(data) ⇒ <code>Array</code>
Returns the places (mainEntity) of all published Articles

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> - places  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| data | <code>Array</code> | array of JSON-LD Articles |

<a name="getPropertyValue"></a>

## getPropertyValue(values, propertyID) ⇒ <code>\*</code>
Returns the value of a PropertyValue with the given propertyID, from a
property such as identifier or additionalProperty

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>\*</code> - value, or undefined if not found  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| values | <code>Array</code> \| <code>Object</code> | one or more PropertyValues |
| propertyID | <code>string</code> |  |

<a name="getFeatureValue"></a>

## getFeatureValue(entity, key) ⇒ <code>\*</code>
Returns the value of an amenityFeature, using its alternateName as the key

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>\*</code> - value, or undefined if not found  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| entity | <code>Object</code> | JSON-LD place |
| key | <code>string</code> |  |

<a name="getFeatureKeys"></a>

## getFeatureKeys(entity) ⇒ <code>Array</code>
Returns the keys (alternateName) of all amenityFeatures whose value is true

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> - keys  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| entity | <code>Object</code> | JSON-LD place |
